'''FC Dunav''' ({{langx|bg|Дунав}}, officially named ''"Дунав от Русе"'') is a [[Bulgaria]]n professional [[association football|football]] club based in [[Ruse, Bulgaria|Ruse]], which will compete in the [[First Professional Football League (Bulgaria)|First League]], the first tier of the [[Bulgarian football league system]], following promotion in 2026.

Part of a larger sports branch, Dunav were established on February 16, 1949, as a merger of two local football clubs in the city, Dinamo and Rusenets.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://fcdunav.eu/%D0%B8%D1%81%D1%82%D0%BE%D1%80%D0%B8%D1%8F/|title = Футболен клуб Дунав – ФК Дунав, футболни събития и прогнози}}</ref> Nicknamed ''The Dragons'' ({{langx|bg|Драконите}}), Dunav's home colours are sky blue and white. Named after the [[Danube River]], on the banks of which the city of Ruse is situated, the club plays its home matches at the local [[Gradski stadion (Ruse)|Gradski stadion]], which has a [[seating capacity]] of 13,000 spectators.<ref>{{cite web | url=https://sport.plovdiv24.bg/719535.html | publisher=(in Bulgarian) Plovdiv24.bg | title=Дунав показа как се прави! Вече над 4000 фенове си купиха билети за мача с Локо | date=26 April 2017 | access-date=28 April 2017}}</ref>

Among the club's most notable achievements are a final in the Bulgarian championship in 1937, a [[A PFG|First League]] fourth place in 1975, 1989 and 2017, and four [[Bulgarian Cup|domestic cup]] finals in 1938, 1939, 1941 and 1962 respectively. The club's most recent top flight participation has been during the [[2019–20 First Professional Football League (Bulgaria)|2019–20 season]]."}}
